headline: Madrid announces 500,000 euros in new aid for wine sector affected by Sierra Oeste fire
summary: The Madrid regional government announced €500,000 in new aid for the wine sector affected by the Sierra Oeste fire. Authorities are considering a fixed €2,500 payment for wineries with production losses from lower grape quality.
why: Wine producers depend on grape harvests, so fire damage to vineyards directly affects their revenue and the regional agricultural economy.
